title: Spike auto-cleanup workflow
description: After SPIKE expires, weekly cron suggests deletion or extension via PR comment.

title: Coverage ratchet: per-module thresholds
description: Currently global 80%. Allow per-module thresholds in baseline.json (e.g., critical billing 90%, ui 70%).

title: ADR auto-link in PR description
description: When PR contains new ADRs in docs/adr/, auto-link them in PR body via GitHub Action.

title: Mutation testing incremental mode
description: Stryker incremental mode for faster CI. Only mutate changed files vs full project scan.

title: Snapshot orphan detection
description: snapshot-validator.js should detect orphan .snap files (no matching test). Currently only checks size.

title: Cross-platform statusline (Windows native)
description: statusline.sh uses bash. Add PowerShell version for native Windows users without Git Bash.

title: Multi-implementation interface detection
description: Pre-edit hook should grep for 2nd implementation when interface created. Currently only blocks I-prefix syntactically.

title: v4: Publish to Claude plugin marketplace
description: Submit code-craftsman to official Claude Code plugin marketplace for one-click install.

title: v3.1: GitHub Actions workflow template
description: Provide .github/workflows/quality-gate.yml template for projects using code-craftsman. Runs ratchet check on every PR.

title: v3: Multi-language support (Python pytest, Go test)
description: Extend hooks/configs to support Python and Go projects. Currently only JS/TS supported. Add: pytest enforcer, Go test enforcer, language detection in install.sh.
